topic: Gemini 4 Hydrogen vs the older model: big multiplication

sentences.text: On big multiplications, the older model got none right.
Gemini 4 Hydrogen got forty-eight of fifty.
The older model was right for four digits, then wrong.
Ninety multiplications, two to ten digits, every digit checked by code.
Up to five digits, Hydrogen was perfect.
Hydrogen missed two, and both were empty replies, not wrong numbers.
One run, with a reply limit.
Two other Gemini 4 models could not be tested.
Would you trust it with your sums?
sentences.editorial: question for viewers, drawn from the measured results

sources.title: AI Tested Gemini 4 Hydrogen multiplication test run

claims.claim: On the fifty multiplications of six to ten digits, answering with only the number, Gemini 4 Hydrogen got 48 right and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite got 0 right.
claims.excerpt: On the fifty multiplications of six to ten digits, answering with only the number, Gemini 4 Hydrogen got 48 right and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite got 0 right.

claims.claim: For 7061156377 × 5926155315, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite's answer matches the correct product for the first four digits and then differs; Gemini 4 Hydrogen's answer matches all twenty digits.
